result.instructions: Tools for Stamped, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers have the highest loyalty points balances?"; "Find the Stamped order linked to platform order ORD-9."; "Show the latest earned or redeemed rewards with coupon codes masked.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Stamped data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stamped_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stamped_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stamped_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. stamped_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stamped_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Filter and list customer records (email, name, tags, addresses, loyalty activity summary such as points and VIP tier). All filters are optional. V3 API: only for shops on the Stamped Loyalty 2.0 dashboard. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/customers.

last_first.description: Match the name filters as last-name-first.

created_from.description: Customer created on the store platform from this date (datePlatformCreated). Passed to Stamped as given (a date such as 2026-10-01, or a Unix timestamp as the dashboard uses).

created_to.description: Customer created on the store platform up to this date (datePlatformCreatedEnd). Passed to Stamped as given (a date such as 2026-10-01, or a Unix timestamp as the dashboard uses).

page.description: Zero-based page number (default 0). Use the reply's more_pages / next_page.

tools.name: stamped_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer record by Stamped customer id (customerId from stamped_list_customers). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: stamped_lookup_customer
tools.title: Look up customer
tools.description: Find one customer by email or by a platform id (give exactly one). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/customers/lookup.

tools.name: stamped_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Filter and list the product catalog Stamped holds (title, vendor, type, handle, status, tags). All filters are optional. V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/products.

page.description: Zero-based page number (default 0). Use the reply's more_pages / next_page.

tools.name: stamped_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by Stamped product id (productId from stamped_list_products). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: stamped_lookup_product
tools.title: Look up product
tools.description: Find one product by a platform id (give exactly one). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/products/lookup.

tools.name: stamped_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List order records Stamped holds (customer id, currency, line items and cart states, discounts applied, dates). Paged; Stamped documents no filters for this list, use stamped_lookup_order for one order. V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/orders.

page.description: Zero-based page number (default 0). Use the reply's more_pages / next_page.

tools.name: stamped_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by Stamped order id (orderId from stamped_list_orders). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: stamped_lookup_order
tools.title: Look up order
tools.description: Find one order by a platform order id (give exactly one). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/orders/lookup.

tools.name: stamped_list_loyalty_rewards
tools.title: List loyalty rewards
tools.description: Loyalty program report: the rewards customers earned or redeemed (title, type, value, status, expiry, customer id, and the coupon code MASKED: only the last 4 characters are shown, codes shorter than 10 characters are fully hidden, and coupon_code_masked is true in the reply). Read-only audit view; nothing is redeemed or voided. V3 API (Loyalty 2.0). GET /api/v3/loyalty/shops/{shopId}/rewards.

page.description: Zero-based page number (default 0). Use the reply's more_pages / next_page.

tools.name: stamped_list_loyalty_activities
tools.title: List loyalty activities
tools.description: Loyalty program report: the points ledger of activities (rule, points credited/debited, event, order id and order breakdown, customer id). Read-only audit view; no points are changed. V3 API (Loyalty 2.0). GET /api/v3/loyalty/shops/{shopId}/activities.

page.description: Zero-based page number (default 0). Use the reply's more_pages / next_page.
